subject: I do not want qplot to sort categorical x variable (bis)

messages.author: 67d9969f93ac5614
messages.subject: I do not want qplot to sort categorical x variable (bis)
parts:
Dear all,

How to avoid qplot to sort my categorical variable?

I had encountered a similar problem before, and then,with the help of the cleaver people in this user group, I could solve it by changing the class of my categorical variable with the function "as.ordered". However, this time this approach is not working.

I have attached the data frame "resTmp". It can be loaded with the function "load".

I have already ordered the variable methodTransfo in a way that 'me' is in ascending order.

But the following call of ggplot disrupts this order (see fig in attach)

   b <- ggplot(resTmp)
   b <- b + geom_bar( aes(x=methodTransfo, y=me) ) + coord_flip()
   b <- b + scale_fill_grey(start=0.8, end=0.1)
   b <- b + theme_bw(base_size=16)
   print(b)

How to avoid this?

Thanks for your help!

Aditya

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: I do not want qplot to sort categorical x variable (bis)
parts:
Hi:

Sorry I didn't see the graph/data at the end of your message. I think this is what you want:

ggplot(resTmp) + geom_bar(aes(x = reorder(methodTransfo, me, mean), y = me)) +
     scale_fill_grey(start=0.8, end=0.1) +
     theme_bw(base_size=16) +
      xlab('methodTransfo')

The reorder() function is useful when you want to order the levels of a factor by some characteristic of another variable - in this case, the value of me.  Since there's only one value for me, any of min, max, mean, median would have worked.

HTH,
Dennis

messages.author: 45a85351148578ad
messages.subject: RE: I do not want qplot to sort categorical x variable (bis)
parts:
Hi Adita,

 

I do not understand very well what you want (e.g. the order is as expected, maybe you want the inverse direction?), but let me try;

 

library(ggplot2)

load("resTmp.dat")

str(resTmp)

b <- ggplot(resTmp)

   b <- b + geom_bar( aes(x=methodTransfo, y=me) ) + coord_flip()

   b <- b + scale_fill_grey(start=0.8, end=0.1)

   b <- b + theme_bw(base_size=16)

   print(b)

n <- length(levels(resTmp$methodTransfo))

resTmp$methodTransfo <- factor( resTmp$methodTransfo, levels = levels(resTmp$methodTransfo)[n:1] )

b %+% resTmp

 

Hope this helps,

fenrnado
